reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the Marrow Agrisupply store whose appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift was **Pine Crossing**.

It comes from her own post in #central-team on 9 June 2026. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver could only see the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10, and the store wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he would check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem.

If "site" means a site code or address, I couldn't find one in the shared files or in the channels she belongs to, and I told her so. I only looked at what Pree can see herself, and I didn't use message search.
